name: What are popular interior design trends for homes in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What are popular interior design trends for homes in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current popular interior design trends in the Bay Area often lean towards sustainable materials, smart home technology integration, and open-concept living spaces that maximize natural light. Natural wood finishes, earthy color palettes, and a blend of modern and vintage elements are also frequently requested. Homeowners often prioritize functional spaces that can adapt for work, relaxation, and entertaining. We also see a continued interest in creating indoor-outdoor flow, especially with the region's mild climate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bay Area interior design trends favor sustainable materials, smart home tech, open layouts, natural light, earthy palettes, and indoor-outdoor flow.
